import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
state=json.loads((root/'outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
verification=json.loads((root/'outputs/v0/verification.json').read_text())
paths=[]
art=state['artifact_paths']
for value in art.values():
    if isinstance(value, str): paths.append(value)
    elif isinstance(value, list): paths.extend(value)
missing=[p for p in paths if not (root/p).exists()]
print('json_valid=True')
print('artifact_paths_checked=',len(paths))
print('missing_artifacts=',missing)
for rel, expected in verification['artifact_hashes_sha256'].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print(rel, 'hash_match=', actual==expected)
print('project_status=',state['status'])
print('next_checkpoint=',state['next_checkpoint'])
PY
rg --files outputs | sort"
